name: Unsuccessful login with invalid credentials
fullName: Zen Portal Login and Logout: Unsuccessful login with invalid credentials

steps.name: Given I am on the Zen Portal login page
Navigate to the Zen Portal login page
When I login with email "invalid_user_test_zenclass@example.com" and password "WrongPassword!123"
Then an error message should be displayed
Verify the credential-error banner is displayed
And I should remain on the login page
Verify the browser stayed on the login page
